decisions.reason: After two selling cycles this condenser should be judged against clearer aspiration levels, but its close fit with the core portfolio and the firm's continued growth and slack still make retention more likely than withdrawal.

This condenser faces the highest withdrawal risk among the remaining products because of overlap with another similar offering, yet management would usually keep it unless performance now clearly falls below aspiration and differentiation proves weak.
The tube liner builds on established repair and service capabilities, supports lifecycle revenues, and likely remains worthwhile unless orders are distinctly below aspiration.

A customized air-cooler line matches the firm's engineering-led solutions model and strategic direction, so behavioral-theory logic suggests continued retention absent strong evidence of persistent underperformance.
These repair inserts complement the aftermarket business and use existing know-how, so the firm is likely to keep them while they contribute to customer retention and service-based learning.
